[SWS_UCM_00018] Providing Progress Information
⌈
UCM shall provide a
method GetSwProcessProgress to query the progress of executing the ProcessS-
wPackage method call for provided transferId. Parameter progress shall be set to a
value representing the progress between 0% and 100% (0x00 ... 0x64).
